svg.title: Chain of Responsibility pattern diagram
svg.desc: A client sends a request into a chain of three handlers. Each handler checks if it can process the request, and if not, passes it to the next handler.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What role does the client play in Chain of Responsibility?')
sendPrompt('How does a handler decide to process or pass a request?')
sendPrompt('What is the final handler in a middleware chain?')
sendPrompt('How does a handler decide to stop or continue the chain?')
sendPrompt('What happens when a handler stops the chain?')
sendPrompt('What does it mean to pass to the next handler?')
sendPrompt('How does the response travel back to the client?')
sendPrompt('What happens if no handler in the chain processes the request?')
